newsitem.title: INDIA: India castorseed prices fall on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: India castorseed prices fall on speculative buying.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Wednesday fell to 1,204/1,205 rupees per quintal from 1,214/1,215 rupees on the back of renewed speculative selling at the improved levels, dealers said.
Overseas buying was lower than expected while improved new crop arrivals prompted bull liquidation. Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region rose to 30,000/35,000 bags (75 kg each).
"Technically market is overbought and may extend losses," one operator said.
Groundnut oil rose by 2/3 rupees at 343/344 rupees per 10 kg on fresh seasonal buying while arrivals were low at 40/50 tonnes.
"Millers in the producing centres have switched over to rapeseed oil which in turn curtailed supplies of groundnut oil," one miller said.
Imported palm oil was quiet at 279/280 rupees per 10 kg amid limited activity. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil rose from 512/513 rupees to 517/518 rupees per 15 kg.
